meta.what: Households per job located in the county, by LODES pay tier and by household income as a share of the county's income limits for its size. [share, standard error] pairs.

sources.income_limits: CHFA — 2026 Income Limit and Maximum Rent Tables for All Colorado Counties, https://www.chfainfo.com/getattachment/620a2abf-e2d3-44a6-868b-4318906acc3e/2026-Rent-and-income-limits.pdf (regular tiers)

meta.workers: Employees (class of worker 1-5) in households, at work last week in Colorado, with wages; each counts 1 / wage and salary workers in the household.
meta.pay_tier: Wages / (weeks worked x 12/52), in 2024 dollars: CE01 <= $1,250 a month, CE02 <= $3,333, CE03 above.
meta.income: Household income in 2026-05 dollars (PUMS 2024 dollars x CPI-U 2026-05 / 2024 average = 1.0647) against the county's CHFA limit for the household size.
meta.standard_error: From the 80 PUMS replicate weights: sqrt(4/80 x sum of squared differences).
meta.le120_cov: Replicate covariance (4/80 x sum of products of differences) of the le120 share between tiers CE01-CE03, for a margin over several tiers.
